semiconductor_relevance: Medium — RS Components Limited is a leading distributor of electronic and electrical components, including those relevant to the semiconductor industry.
summary: RS Components Limited provides a wide range of electronic, electrical, and industrial components, serving engineers and purchasing professionals globally. Their extensive product catalog includes items essential for semiconductor applications, such as connectors, enclosures, and test equipment.

regional_presence.Taiwan: RS Components has a branch in Taiwan, serving local customers with a wide range of electronic components.
